programs.title: The 90-Day Pregnancy Prep Program
programs.subtitle: Build a strong, flexible body, ready for what comes next.

weeks.themeSubtitle: The original week: connect to the core that will carry you through.

days.title: Core Connection
days.intention: Today I prepare for pregnancy by building a strong link to my deep core.

days.title: Prepare for Load
days.intention: Today I prepare for pregnancy by loosening up my back and hips.

days.title: Strong Core Foundation
days.intention: Today I prepare for pregnancy by waking the corset muscle that wraps around and protects my bump.

days.title: Pelvic Stability
days.intention: Today I prepare for pregnancy by building a steady pelvis, ready to carry extra weight.

days.title: Glute Power
days.intention: Today I prepare for pregnancy by building strong glutes to keep back pain away.

days.title: Functional Movement
days.intention: Today I prepare for pregnancy by learning how to move safely as my body changes.

days.title: Body Confidence
days.intention: Today I prepare for pregnancy by feeling strong, steady, and ready.

weeks.themeSubtitle: Map your breath, core, and pelvic floor before you build on them.

days.title: Breath Before Bump
days.intention: Breath and bracing today build the quiet strength a changing body relies on. This week is about foundations: notice more, force nothing. Let this be your time: no rush, no judgment, just practice.

days.title: Core Insurance
days.intention: Today strengthens the deep corset muscle that will hold and support your growing bump. We are laying groundwork this week, so keep everything slow and curious. Move at your own pace and let your breath lead the way.

days.title: Space to Grow
days.intention: Today we open the hips and spine so pregnancy finds a flexible, welcoming frame. Early weeks are for learning your body's signals, not chasing burn. Small, honest efforts today are what your body remembers tomorrow.

days.title: The Carrying Muscles
days.intention: We train your body's carrying muscles today, before they are needed. This week is about foundations: notice more, force nothing. Show up gently. Showing up, not pushing hard, is the win.

days.title: Center of Gravity Prep
days.intention: We challenge your stability today so nothing later catches you off guard. We are laying groundwork this week, so keep everything slow and curious. Notice how you feel before and after; that awareness is progress too.

days.title: Life-Ready Strength
days.intention: Today rehearses the safe lifting and rising patterns you will use constantly as a parent. Early weeks are for learning your body's signals, not chasing burn. You are exactly where you need to be in this process.

days.title: Recovery Ritual
days.intention: Recovery is where your body absorbs the week's work, so give it room today. Early weeks are for learning your body's signals, not chasing burn. Give yourself full credit for pressing play today.

weeks.themeSubtitle: Make waking your deep core second nature.

days.title: Deep Connection Day
days.intention: Today you train the breath-core connection that will support you through every trimester. We are building the habit now, with steady, repeatable, unhurried work. Trust the work. Your body is quietly getting stronger every session.

days.title: Corset Work
days.intention: Precise core training today is insurance for your back and pelvis later. Your consistency this week wires in the connection we built earlier. Let this be your time: no rush, no judgment, just practice.

days.title: Hip Openers for Later
days.intention: Gentle stretching today keeps your pelvis balanced and your back happy. This phase is about switching on the right muscles at the right moment. Move at your own pace and let your breath lead the way.

days.title: Bridge to Baby
days.intention: Hip and glute strength today is the gift that keeps giving for nine months. We are building the habit now, with steady, repeatable, unhurried work. Small, honest efforts today are what your body remembers tomorrow.

days.title: Standing Strong
days.intention: Your balance point shifts as your body changes. Today we train the steadiness that keeps you upright anyway. Your consistency this week wires in the connection we built earlier. Show up gently. Showing up, not pushing hard, is the win.

days.title: The Functional Edit
days.intention: Functional strength today means everyday movements stay easy as your body changes. This phase is about switching on the right muscles at the right moment. Notice how you feel before and after; that awareness is progress too.

days.title: Slow Sunday
days.intention: Let today feel like a long breath out: slow movement, deep breathing, no pressure. This phase is about switching on the right muscles at the right moment. Move at your own pace and let your breath lead the way.

weeks.themeSubtitle: Open hips and spine so your body adapts gracefully to change.

days.title: The Adaptable Body

days.title: Strong Hips Ahead
days.intention: Strong glutes today mean a supported back when you are carrying extra weight later. Your consistency this week wires in the connection we built earlier. Move at your own pace and let your breath lead the way.

days.title: Poise Practice
days.intention: Single-leg work today builds the stability a changing body depends on. This phase is about switching on the right muscles at the right moment. Small, honest efforts today are what your body remembers tomorrow.

days.title: Moves You'll Need
days.intention: We train hinges and lunges today, the building blocks of a strong pregnancy. We are building the habit now, with steady, repeatable, unhurried work. Show up gently. Showing up, not pushing hard, is the win.

days.title: Gentle Landing
days.intention: This restore day protects everything you built this week; sink into it. We are building the habit now, with steady, repeatable, unhurried work. Notice how you feel before and after; that awareness is progress too.
